decisions.reason: Glossary System plus returning senses is closer to 시스템 알림 and 감각들이 than lowercase system/sensations.
Beneath my back is the natural lying-on-a-bed reading of 등을 타고 전해지는 푹신함.

Source correction is 한 몬스터와 인간; SOL reverses monster/human order.
Matches vocative 조금 덜 간악한 인간이여 without BASE’s added You’re…now.
얼떨떨한 목소리로 is a dazed voice; SOL moves stunned off the voice.
그렇게 깨웠는데 is that much waking, not we tried everything, and Choi is speaking.
Damn, he was intense is spoken Taekyung for 박력 보소; Talk about force is calqued.
Habitual composure-plus-bragging then Now contrasts 자랑하던 with present 번갯불이 튀고 있었다 more cleanly.
Worth slapping me over is the natural idiom for 따귀까지 맞을 일인가.
그 순간 is That was when; Then— drops the moment-cliff.
Drowned out is the English for a voice 파묻혔다; I assumed matches 짐작되는.
What the hell matches 도대체…거지 after 시벌 better than What on earth.
Hit me with preserves 날아들었다; delivered flattens the incoming line.
Chinese Central Committee is the natural English for 중국 중앙위원회.
To have come into view matches 지금쯤이면 already-visible 보여도.
SOL drops 무심코.
Korean first shows the huge airport from height, then flames and dots; SOL leads with flames and loses that vista.
Fight to the death keeps 죽고 죽이는; deadly battle weakens it.
내가 타고 있는 전용기 is the jet he is riding, not our jet.
Classified as dragonkin is the tight reading of 용족으로 분류되는.
십여 is ten-odd/more than ten, not around a dozen.
내가 탄 전용기 is the jet carrying him; my private jet implies ownership.
Already captures 어느새; top-tier is accurate for 최상위.
SOL’s humans and monster alike is ungrammatical; source is 몬스터고 인간이고.
이성 is sanity/reason, not composure (침착 comes later).
What you’re afraid of is tighter spoken English for 걱정하시는 일은 일어나지 않을 겁니다.
Reliable as ever restates 역시 already covered by As expected; 믿음직하다 is simply reliable.
타개할 is overcome/break through the crisis, not merely a way out.
Take care of it is natural spoken 해결해 줄 겁니다.
I trust you, Mr. Jin Taekyung is how English addresses him; BASE sounds like talking about him.
SOL adds the hell; 왜 날 믿냐고 has no 도대체-level intensifier.
Putting his faith…help more is more natural for 믿는 게 더 도움이 될 것 같은데 in this trust beat.
Preserves 순간 and 시선이 우수수 날아와 꽂힌다; SOL adds stood and replaces flying gazes with snapped.
특별히 요청 is a special request, not personally requested his help.
Rejoice, my legion! carries the imperative 기뻐하라, 군단이여 better than a period.
Grounds for my trust keeps the 근거 callback from 근거 없는/근거 있는.
Restores source ……! that BASE dropped.
피해 갈 수 있을 is avoid any danger, not make it through.
Under my breath then spoke up naturalizes 내심 작게 중얼거린…입을 열었다.
Tighter inference for 붙잡고…있을 것이다 without repeating the captain.
얼마나 충격적이었는지 is actual shock, not BASE’s must have been conjecture.
Keeps SOL’s 열지도 못할뿐더러 flow and cabin We, but 파손될 is damaged, not break apart.
decisions.replacement: “Of course not! The pressure-sealing system won’t even let you open it, and the aircraft will be damaged because it can’t withstand the pressure difference! We won’t be able to breathe properly, either!”

decisions.reason: 만지작거리며 is simultaneous while fiddling, not sequential and cut in.
막을 수 is block, the tighter verb before Barrier; hold back is a needless synonym.
Right in front of carries 감히…앞에서; SOL drops the emphasis.
Turned white matches 하얗게 질렸다 better than pale, with natural 말실수 realization.
팍 씨 is a completed curse, not SOL’s invented truncated Why, I ought to.
Restores source ……! that BASE dropped.
Ahhh! preserves elongated 아앗 versus repeated Ah.
Before the captain could stop me is cleaner English for 말릴 틈도 없이.
Cut it open is the natural reading of 잘랐다 on the door; cut one open is awkward.
불리는 is called; 작은 문 is a small door, not doorway.
Cleaner parallel for 초절정 고수가 그렇듯, 이곳에서는 S급 헌터만이 without calqued Just as…could do.
엉망 is a mess and 되고 있었으니까 is progressive; chaos plus simple past drifts.
Snapped…back to his senses is the natural causal English for 비명과 내 외침에 정신을 차린.
Airtight matches 빈틈없는 (no gaps) for a pressure barrier better than impenetrable.
Tighter With the incantation…slightest gap for 주문 영창과 함께…물 샐 틈 없이.
Drops needless Because while keeping ally-recognition and unresisted passage.
One elongated rumble matches 쿠구구구구; Rumble, rumble splits it.
후려치는 is slam/batter; 압사라도 시킬 것처럼 is crush to death; neither candidate has both.
decisions.replacement: The wind pressure slammed into my upper body as if trying to crush me to death. I grinned.

decisions.reason: Wasn’t unbearable is the tight reading of 못 견딜 정도는 아니다; SOL is wordier.
Actually fits self-correcting 아니; 내뿜던 기파 is emitted, not unleashed.
The monster’s sharp cry mixed into keeps 몬스터의 and 섞여 들어온다; SOL’s A and mingled with detach it.
이 정도 거리라면 충분 is at this distance, enough, not close enough.
Inventory as a UI command should match capitalized Equip.
All the way back is 한껏; needed muscles like a bowstring is more natural than far/necessary/bowstrings.
Lead wyvern—their chief—sensed is cleaner apposition for 선두의 우두머리…눈치챈.
Preserves 빨려 들어가는 and 것이 보였다; SOL’s rushed toward its maw drops the suction and seeing.
브레스다 is It’s Breath, not It’s using Breath.
Of all…only matches 중에서도 오직; gaping maw matches 쩍 벌어진 주둥이.
Air Breath is the named 에어 브레스; finished taking shape continues 완전한 형체를 갖춘.
캬우 is shorter than 캬우우; SOL lengthens it to Kyaau.
Burning through the air is the natural collocation for 공기를 태우고 on a fire-qi throw.
터져 나가는 is bursting outward from the tip, not exploding at it.
Plummeted is the natural verb for 추락하는 after the kite-string image.
십여 쌍 is more than ten pairs, consistent with 십여 not a dozen.
지금 이 순간 is this moment, not that moment.
Even among their own kind preserves 동족 중에서도; BASE’s member of their species drops it.
SOL drops 제대로 from 제대로 본 놈도 없었다.
Source trails off with …… mid-thought; a completed question mark closes it.
Colon already introduces what they saw; dash is churn.
Get their revenge is already idiomatic for 복수하기로; take revenge is mere synonym swap.
Would they matches past-tense narration of 할 수 있을까 better than Will they.
십여 쌍 of wings is more than ten pairs, consistent with the other 십여 counts.
